_doc: Constructed fist, 144 px, ROUND 2 variant r3 (glaive-hands lane; author_hands.py template='r3'). Same canonical frame as r1/r2: the haft vertical through haft_cols (tip up), the thumb end at the top, the knuckles on the LEFT, the forearm entering from the RIGHT. Round-2 critique: 'no knuckle line, no thumb wedge and no wrist step'; in the r2 stills the fist read as S1 with S4 dots (the n separations and a sheared l column broke into specks). r3 builds it from four value groups and continuous lines only: the finger band (k, S3) on the knuckle side; ONE knuckle line (l, S4) bowing toward the fingers in the middle rows (HD-P02: middle knuckle highest); the lit knuckle ridge (r, S1) beside it; the back of the hand (b, S2) with its far edge (B, S3); the thumb wedge (t, S1) crossing the haft on the near side with its underside (T, S3) and a 3 px crease (c, S4) under it; the pinky end (d, S3); the wrist (w, S3: the 1 px wrist step, a darker column between hand and forearm). No finger separations at 144 (HD-N02 allows up to two; on a 6-col interior they speckle). O = OL always. 'codes' fixes the tones (the one key light is on the lit side of every lane grip; plane_codes is not used for r3).
